title: The fundamental group of a spherical space form is not audible
summary: We revisit the problem of isospectral spherical space forms with non-cyclic fundamental groups after the works by Ikeda, Gilkey and Wolf. We find the first pair of spherical space forms with non-isomorphic fundamental groups and the same Laplace spectrum. This shows that the isomorphism class of the fundamental group is not audible among spherical space forms. We also found several instances where one can hear the fundamental group of a spherical space form (among spherical space forms).
